verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers login flows, MFA, RBAC, SSO, Organizations, and AI-agent auth, but contains no documentation or community evidence about session expiry configuration, refresh token rotation, or server-side revocation of an active/compromised session — a core session-management capability any auth platform buyer would expect to see addressed. This axis clearly applies to an authentication product like Auth0, so absence of evidence yields 'none' rather than 'na'.
